searchText: Hey party people, there's been a level of interest in doing a point release for beacon-apis for devnet-6. I'll probably do this within the next 24 hours - just wondering is there anything else that's not already in that's needed for devnet-6? What does https://ethereum.github.io/beacon-APIs/#/Beacon/getBlockV2 return if there are two blocks at the requested slot? It should only ever return canonical blocks. well, when requesting by number... So even if there's only one block at a specified slot, it won't be returned if it isn't canonical. https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/325 if any maintainers are about <@602753420033785856> approved! https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/326 i pushed it so that 2.4.1 would show on web page, but can further adjust changes if i mis-understood the suggestions Seeing errors on the 2.4.1 release: https://validator.swagger.io/validator/debug?url=https%3A%2F%2Fethereum.github.io%2Fbeacon-APIs%2Freleases%2Fv2.4.1%2Fbeacon-node-oapi.json Gotcha - thanks! 🙂
